_about: What a Walk Avatar package contains. Read by scripts/build-extension.mjs (Chromium: Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons) and extensions/firefox/build.mjs (Firefox Add-ons) so every store ships the same files. background.js is an ES module; every other entrypoint is a classic IIFE because chrome.scripting.executeScript and the popup/options pages load them as plain scripts. content-narrator.js is injected before content.js and publishes a window global, so it must stay a separate entrypoint.
